sources.independence_basis: Distinct security research organizations provide original technical descriptions of the same exploit; no attribution to each other appears in either reviewed body. SolidityScan is the CredShields security publication, separate from BlockSec.

identity_basis.review: BlockSec explicitly identifies the attack transaction on Phalcon with optimism in the URL; SolidityScan explicitly labels the identical optimistic.etherscan.io transaction as attacker transaction. Other linked siblings are not admitted under this pair.
